title: Felt wargame extension: combat resolution table (CRT)
description: Write CRT logic in Felt. Functions: odds_ratio(attackers, defenders) computes attack/defense strength ratio. crt_column(ratio) maps to CRT column index. crt_resolve(column, die_roll) returns combat result string (DE/DR/EX/AR/NE). apply_effect dispatches on trigger=combat to resolve CRT. Terrain defense modifiers shift column. CRT data embedded as Felt lookup functions.
close_reason: crt.felt implements attack/defense strengths, odds ratio, CRT lookup table, terrain modifiers. Type-checks cleanly.
